title: getrandom preflight before RSA encrypt to surface OS RNG failure before panic-only path
description: build_rsa_recipient() calls getrandom::fill() on 256 bytes before invoking rsa::encrypt(), converting a silent panic into a SmimeError::RngFailure on OS RNG failure. This is the right approach given that the rsa crate takes an UnwrapErr(SysRng) that panics on failure. A future contributor might remove the preflight as 'unnecessary overhead' — this would silently convert a recoverable error back into a panic.
close_reason: Confirmed: encrypt.rs build_rsa_recipient (lines 278-280) performs a 256-byte getrandom::fill preflight before calling rsa::encrypt(). The comment documents the TOCTOU window. The preflight converts an otherwise-silent panic (rsa uses UnwrapErr(SysRng) internally) into a SmimeError::RngFailure on OS RNG failure. The let _ = preflight; line is intentional — the bytes serve only to test RNG liveness.
